_comment: create case pool: one row = one complete runnable case (productType + ownership fields embedded in the same row).
Discipline: every row must be same-source captured from a single real curl (create the order in the system's web UI + DevTools Copy as cURL);
assembling fields across rows/files is forbidden — a hand-built combination may be an ownership relationship that does not exist in reality (see README.md in this directory).
The dat file is located by the same-name convention: data/datfiles/products/<productType>/<productType>.dat; rows do not carry paths.
Row SHAPE calibrated against a real intranet capture (2026-08-06): notionalCurrency may legitimately be an empty string (server infers);
counterpartyFmId is an 8-digit numeric string; portfolioId may differ per row. VALUES below remain placeholder fakes (well-formed, pass preflight) —
real captured values live only in the intranet copy and are never committed; record capture time and source in note.
